note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (44 mm case, listing; strap 21.58 mm measured against 22 mm listed). Heights before the house depth scale (12 mm thick listing). Dial print, Roman numerals, subdial print, logo, minute track and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: (r, z): polished steel case, flank rounding into the wide sloped polished bezel (18.94-22 mm in the photo); inner lip holds the crystal; 12 mm thick listing

guard.note: crown guard shoulders above and below the crown, outline from the right silhouette (2.1 mm past the case circle)

lug.note: wide polished lugs with a sloped top (front photo and 3/4 view)

dial.note: flat dial to the minute track's inner edge, the track a shallow cone up to the bezel lip

hands.note: polished steel frames with raised white lume (hour, minute); steel chronograph seconds with a round counterweight; steel subdial needles all at 12 (photo)

pusher.note: round pushers at 2 and 4 with a short tube and a chamfered cap

crown.note: large knurled steel crown at 3 between the guard shoulders

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (25.75 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: case, bezel, lugs, guard, pushers, crown, hands, hubs

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
